title: Saltwater
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Saltwater.” Show a woman floating face-up in an enormous indoor swimming pool at night, but make the water indistinguishable from a dark ocean. Her body should be very small in the composition, drifting near the lower third while pale artificial pool lights disappear into impossible depths below her. One broken white feather floats several feet away, almost unnoticed. The tiled edge of the pool should vanish into darkness so the location feels simultaneously domestic and infinite. Photograph it like an obscure 1970s art-film still using grainy 35mm film, muted teal-black water, washed ivory skin tones, slight underexposure, halation around the lights and imperfect focus. The feeling should be obsessive affection, fragility and surrender rather than romance in a conventional sense. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders, album artwork, a literal beach house, or recognisable Beach House iconography. Make it mysterious enough that the connection is emotional rather than literal.

title: Tokyo Witch
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Tokyo Witch.” Depict a nearly empty mahjong parlour in Tokyo during a winter night. Fluorescent ceiling lights cast a sickly green-white glow over rows of vacant tables, while one solitary figure sits at the furthest table with their back to the camera. Through fogged windows, red neon characters dissolve into falling snow. A few mahjong tiles have spilled onto the floor in the foreground, but one tile appears inexplicably scorched black. Let a red flowering branch intrude from somewhere impossible, perhaps emerging from a wall or ventilation grate. Photograph it as if found on expired Japanese 35mm film from the late 1980s, with heavy grain, colour shifts, faint scratches and deep shadow detail. The mood should combine patience, mystery, loneliness and a sense that someone has been waiting for years. Do not include any text, lyrics, logos, borders or copied album imagery.

title: Apple Orchard
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Apple Orchard.” Show two old-fashioned pillows lying directly beneath an apple tree at dusk, as though someone had made a temporary bed in the grass and then disappeared. Several empty wooden picture frames are scattered nearby, some upright against the tree and some lying face-down. Windfall apples surround them, but nearly all are pale and desaturated except for one unnaturally deep red apple positioned near the bottom edge. A wool blanket trails out of frame. The orchard beyond should dissolve into fog and darkness, with rows of trees becoming barely visible repetitions. Photograph it in soft-focus medium-format film with muted cream, tobacco brown, moss green and faded crimson, slightly fogged optics, subtle lens bloom and organic grain. It should feel comforting at first glance and quietly sad on longer inspection. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders, people posing for the camera or any existing album artwork.

title: Master of None
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Master of None.” Stage an elegant but unsettling house party after everyone has left. The foreground should contain a dining chair covered with dozens of loose black and white feathers as though a bird had vanished there. In the background, a full-length mirror reflects an empty room even though a blurred human figure is visibly standing directly in front of it. Champagne glasses, cigarette ash and abandoned coats imply a party without showing any identifiable guests. Use harsh direct flash combined with deep black shadows, creating the aesthetic of an anonymous early-1980s nightlife photograph. Keep colours mostly ivory, nicotine yellow, black and dark burgundy. Make the composition socially glamorous but emotionally vacant, suggesting possession, performance and a person who cannot truly belong anywhere. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or literal visualisations of the song title.

title: Auburn and Ivory
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Auburn and Ivory.” Show the profile of a young woman standing extremely still beside a winter sea, photographed from far enough away that she feels almost like a figure in an old family photograph. Her auburn hair should be tied back, and she should wear an ivory coat. Beside her on a stone wall is a small stack of handwritten letters whose pages catch warm sunlight and appear nearly gold. A tiny fire burns in a metal bowl several metres behind her, sending sparks horizontally in the coastal wind. The sea and sky should be pale, overexposed and nearly merge into one flat white field. Shoot it in faded 1960s colour film with soft grain, subdued auburn, ivory and sea-grey tones and slightly damaged emulsion at the edges. The image should suggest memory, restraint and heartbreak without melodrama. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or album-cover recreation.

title: Childhood
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Childhood.” Photograph an abandoned upstairs landing in an old family home at late afternoon. A staircase descends into complete darkness. On the landing lie several broken or discarded childhood toys: a wooden horse missing one leg, faded plastic building blocks, a small stuffed animal with one button eye and a toy car covered with dust. Warm harvest-coloured sunlight enters from a window out of frame and illuminates only the toys, while the rest of the architecture feels cold and empty. Through a distant open doorway, show a vague glimpse of tall dry grass moving outside, almost as though the house has been swallowed by a field. Use faded 1970s home-film colour, pronounced grain, light leaks and slightly soft focus. The image should feel like discovering that a place from childhood still exists but no longer belongs to you. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or people.

title: Wedding Bell
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Wedding Bell.” Show a small antique brass handbell resting in the centre of an unmade double bed. The bed is surrounded by dark seawater that has somehow flooded the bedroom to mattress height, yet the sheets remain strangely dry. Two impressions in the pillows suggest people were lying there moments earlier. A narrow window reveals an overcast ocean horizon even though this is clearly an upstairs domestic room. Photograph the scene in warm, dim tungsten light mixed with cool grey daylight, using grainy medium-format film and slightly faded colours. The bell should not look ceremonial or luxurious, just intimate and ordinary. The image should evoke devotion, vows, shared interiors and the instability of trying to keep something alive. Avoid wedding clichés such as brides, bouquets or churches. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or album-cover imagery.

title: You Came to Me
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “You Came to Me.” Depict an overgrown garden at dawn containing a tiny rowboat inexplicably resting among tall flowers rather than water. Inside the boat is a carefully wrapped gift with a faded ribbon, a handful of wildflowers and an old diamond ring lying loose on one seat. A narrow garden path disappears into dense foliage behind it. At the far end of the path, a human silhouette should be barely visible through mist, ambiguous enough that it might be a person or simply a trick of foliage. Photograph it with soft early-morning natural light, faded greens, pale pinks and cream, delicate film grain and shallow focus reminiscent of an old European family photograph. The image should feel like a dream delivering a message from someone absent. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or literal dream clouds.

title: Gila
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Gila.” Show an old stone wishing well in a dry, nearly colourless landscape at midday. Hundreds of tarnished pennies surround the rim and spill into the dirt, yet the interior of the well is completely black and impossible to see into. On the horizon, a tiny cargo ship appears impossibly far inland, as though waiting to arrive across a desert. Place a cheap plastic toy crown beside the well, half buried in dust. Photograph with harsh sun, bleached film colour, deep black shadows, slight heat haze and a subtly surreal perspective. The scene should evoke someone spending the past, making offerings, expecting rescue and refusing to understand that the ship may never arrive. Keep it austere rather than fantastical. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, fantasy characters or direct album imagery.

title: Turtle Island
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Turtle Island.” Photograph a small wooden dock extending into a perfectly still green pond at sunset. At the end of the dock sits an empty folding chair facing the water. Deer leap over a distant hedge in the soft background, captured with slight motion blur. Under the murky surface near the dock, the faint shape of a human face seems to appear only through reflection and submerged vegetation, ambiguous rather than supernatural. A tiny turtle rests on one plank in the foreground. Use quiet 35mm film aesthetics, moss green water, faded amber sunset, muted brown wood, natural grain and gentle underexposure. The mood should be one of waiting for someone, memory preserved in a landscape and the uncomfortable beauty of something you cannot keep. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or obvious fantasy effects.

title: Heart of Chambers
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Heart of Chambers.” Create an intimate photograph of a tiny bedroom whose architecture resembles a sequence of nested chambers. An old iron bed sits in the smallest central room, visible through two aligned doorways. On the bed are several open picture books, pressed flowers and a pair of reading glasses. The walls are pale but worn, with faint outlines where framed pictures once hung. A warm rectangle of sun falls across the bed while every surrounding room remains dark. The perspective should pull the eye inward like entering someone’s heart through successive rooms. Photograph on slightly faded medium-format film with cream walls, iron grey, dusty rose and muted gold, soft grain and subtle lens bloom. The feeling should be fragile, private and deeply human rather than gothic. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, visible hearts or literal anatomical imagery.

title: Astronaut
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Astronaut.” Show a modest kitchen table prepared for two people: two teacups, a sugar bowl, a glass of lemonade and a single empty chair. Through the window directly behind the table, instead of a backyard, reveal the blackness of outer space and a tiny astronaut floating far away as though returning home. A bright yellow cat sits on the windowsill calmly watching the figure approach. Make everything inside the room warm, ordinary and tactile, while the space outside is impossibly vast. Photograph it like a 1970s colour film still, with warm cream, faded yellow and walnut brown indoors contrasting with deep blue-black space. Add natural grain, slight softness and realistic practical lighting. The surrealism should feel matter-of-fact, not science-fiction spectacular. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or spaceships.

title: Zebra
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Zebra.” Photograph a wide empty salt flat under a white sky. Across the landscape run alternating black and white bands that initially resemble zebra stripes but gradually reveal themselves to be shadows and reflected light across shallow water. Near the centre, a distant pair of human figures lie side by side on the ground, almost too small to notice. The striped landscape should appear to pulse or curve unnaturally toward them, suggesting repetition and something happening again. Use high-contrast black-and-white medium-format film, visible grain, silver halation and slight motion blur in parts of the stripes. Avoid showing an actual zebra. The image should be hypnotic, bodily and ambiguous, like an optical phenomenon accidentally photographed. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or copied Teen Dream imagery.

title: Silver Soul
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Silver Soul.” Show a human figure standing alone in a dark room covered entirely in reflective silver emergency blankets. The person’s face should be invisible because a camera flash turns the reflective material around them into a blinding white burst. In the foreground, several tarnished silver objects lie scattered on the floor: a compact mirror, a coin, a chain and an empty picture frame. The room should feel both glamorous and claustrophobic. Photograph with hard direct flash on high-grain black-and-white film, allowing the metallic surfaces to bloom and partially erase themselves. A faint double exposure of the same figure should appear offset by a few centimetres, implying repetition or recurrence. Keep it poetic and imperfect, not futuristic. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or literal souls.

title: Norway
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Norway.” Depict a small dark wooden house deep in a snow-covered Scandinavian forest at blue hour. One tiny upstairs window glows warm amber. In the foreground, seven indistinct human silhouettes walk single-file between the trees, but their tracks in the snow strangely stop before reaching the house. Millions of tiny ice crystals in the air catch the light like stars. A barely visible animal shape stands farther back between tree trunks, uncertain whether it is a deer, dog or something more threatening. Photograph with expired colour film, cool cyan snow, black wood and one point of amber light, soft grain and slight underexposure. The image should feel inviting from afar yet quietly dangerous up close. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders, flags or travel-postcard imagery.

title: Walk in the Park
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Walk in the Park.” Photograph an empty public park immediately after rain. A paved path curves toward an ornate doorway standing by itself among the trees with no building attached. In the glass of the door, faintly reflect a person who is not present anywhere in the actual scene. On a nearby bench, two wet handprints appear side by side and slowly fade into the wood. Use overcast daylight, muted green vegetation, damp grey pavement and warm brown wood on subdued 35mm film. Include slight fog and fine grain, keeping the composition realistic enough that the impossible doorway initially seems normal. The feeling should be the quiet dissociation of walking somewhere familiar after a relationship has ended and noticing absence everywhere. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or obvious ghost effects.

title: Used to Be
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Used to Be.” Show an old suburban living room being emptied during a move. Faded wallpaper contains pale rectangular marks where photographs used to hang. One cardboard box sits open in the middle of the carpet, filled with objects from another decade: a cassette tape, house key, Polaroids, a child’s ribbon and a dried flower. Sunlight from a low evening window stretches across the empty floor. In the far corner, a television displays only static. Photograph it like a faded snapshot taken on consumer film in the late 1980s, with warm colour cast, grain, slight flash falloff and imperfect framing. The image should make the viewer feel the physical residue of a previous version of a life. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or visible people.

title: Lover of Mine
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Lover of Mine.” Photograph two figures standing several metres apart inside a vast dark ballroom after a dance. Their faces should be obscured by shadow. Between them, a broad strip of polished floor catches a pale spotlight, but neither person steps into it. Scattered white gloves and wilted flowers remain from the event. One chandelier is still lit while every other fixture is dark. Use soft-focus 35mm colour film with faded burgundy, cream and black, subtle grain and a slight haze from smoke or dust. The scene should convey desire held at a distance and the strange formality of knowing someone intimately but not being able to reach them. Avoid embraces, kisses or romantic clichés. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or recognisable album art.

title: Real Love
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Real Love.” Show a cheap motel room in the minutes before sunrise. Two sides of the bed are visibly disturbed, yet the room is empty. The bedside lamp remains on despite pale morning light entering through thin curtains. On the carpet is a small pile of ice slowly melting beside a plastic hotel cup, creating a dark wet stain. A mirror above the dresser reflects only the bright window rather than the rest of the room. Photograph in grainy, desaturated 35mm with washed peach, cream, nicotine yellow and early-morning blue. Let the exposure feel slightly wrong, as though the photographer took one hurried frame before leaving. The emotional tone should be tenderness stripped of fantasy, something genuine but difficult rather than sentimental. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or explicit figures.

title: Take Care
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Take Care.” Photograph an elderly person’s hands carefully fastening the coat buttons of a younger adult whose face is outside the frame. The setting is a dim house entryway at night, with an open front door revealing falling snow. A pair of old shoes, an umbrella and a small table with medication bottles and a glass of water sit quietly in the background. Focus primarily on the gesture of the hands, with shallow depth of field and warm tungsten light against cool blue exterior light. Use intimate 35mm documentary photography, fine grain, subdued browns and creams, realistic skin texture and slight motion blur. The image should communicate devotion through an ordinary act of care rather than romantic symbolism. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders, visible faces or staged sentimentality.

title: Myth
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Myth.” Show a two-lane desert road dividing at an impossible three-way fork beneath a huge white sun. Several road arrows painted on the asphalt point in conflicting directions and appear partially melted or washed away. Ash drifts across the road like snow. Far in the distance, the canyon walls seem to contain the faint outline of a human profile, visible only after looking carefully. Photograph in faded colour with sun-bleached ochre, pale blue and chalk white, heavy analogue grain, heat haze and a small light leak along one edge. The image should suggest a person constructing a story to explain where they are going and then watching that story dissolve. Avoid fantasy illustration. Make it look like a real location captured at a psychologically strange moment. No text, lyrics, logos or borders.

title: Wild
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Wild.” Photograph a glossy black car parked with its headlights off in an enormous field of knee-high green grass at twilight. One rear door is open. A pair of bare legs is barely visible inside, but no face or body is clearly identifiable. The green landscape extends without fences to the horizon while storm clouds gather overhead. A faint trail of crushed grass behind the car suggests it drove far from any road. Use rich but slightly degraded 35mm colour film, deep green, black lacquer and violet-grey sky, with soft grain and mild underexposure. The image should capture youthful danger, secrecy and the feeling that there is no time left to decide whether to get in. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or conventional road-trip imagery.

title: Lazuli
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Lazuli.” Create an almost-monochrome photograph of a human figure submerged waist-deep in a room filled with an impossibly intense lapis-blue light. The architecture should be plain and domestic, perhaps an empty hallway, but every surface gradually disappears into blue. The person holds a small irregular piece of lapis lazuli in an outstretched hand, though it should be difficult to distinguish from the surrounding colour. Their face is turned away. Photograph as if shot on colour film pushed several stops, creating coarse grain, blooming highlights and slight cyan-violet shifts. Let the edges of objects become indistinct so that colour itself feels like a physical place. The mood should be irreplaceability, immersion and being unable to separate a person from the atmosphere they left behind. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or gemstone-commercial aesthetics.

title: Other People
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Other People.” Photograph a row of six old payphones mounted along a wall at night. Five receivers hang neatly in place while the sixth dangles by its cord. Every phone is lit from above by the same fluorescent strip, but the dangling phone casts two shadows instead of one. Beyond the glass wall behind them is a distant city blurred by rain. No humans should be visible. Use cool, desaturated 35mm colour with green-grey fluorescent light, wet reflections, fine grain and soft depth of field. The image should evoke failed attempts to remain connected, the strange persistence of other lives after a relationship changes and the loneliness of communication technology after everyone has left. Avoid obvious broken-heart imagery. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or visible phone numbers.

title: The Hours
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “The Hours.” Show the interior of a tall abandoned observation tower. A narrow spiral staircase rises through the frame toward a small square of daylight at the top. Hundreds of pressed flowers are pinned to the walls at different heights, becoming darker and more damaged as the staircase ascends. On one landing, a convex mirror reflects a pair of frightened eyes even though no person is standing there. Use high-grain black-and-white film with strong silver contrast, long shadows and slight blur around the mirror. The composition should create a vertical pull upward while still feeling trapped. It should suggest time accumulating, memory stored as evidence and the compulsion to climb high enough to finally understand what happened. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or clocks.

title: New Year
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “New Year.” Photograph a teenage girl’s portrait taped to the middle of a large otherwise blank wall. Around the portrait are hundreds of faint coloured rectangles where other photographs, notes and calendars have been removed. A single unopened handwritten letter lies on the floor directly beneath it. Morning light falls diagonally across the wall, splitting the portrait so that half is illuminated and half remains in shadow. Use faded Polaroid-like colour, pale mint, peach, cream and dusty blue with visible grain, minor chemical streaks and slight colour instability. The room should feel as though someone has carefully erased an entire year but forgotten one image. The mood should be anticipation, identity changing through memory and the quiet ending of an era. Do not include legible writing, text, lyrics, logos or borders.

title: Wishes
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Wishes.” Photograph a circular carnival ride standing completely still in the middle of an immaculate suburban lawn at dusk. Instead of seats, dozens of red roses hang from its rotating arms by thin strings. The roses all point outward as though the wheel had just stopped spinning. A hill rises behind it and is covered with identical dark houses whose windows remain unlit. Use a centred, symmetrical composition on dreamy medium-format colour film, with faded lawn green, deep rose red, cream sky and slight underexposure. Add subtle motion ghosting around a few roses to imply that the structure was moving seconds earlier. The image should feel beautiful, absurd and faintly ominous, capturing desire repeating in circles and the ache produced when memory makes contact with the present. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or fairground crowds.

title: On the Sea
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “On the Sea.” Show a monumental stone staircase descending directly into a dark ocean. The upper steps begin on land and are dry; lower steps disappear under waves. Halfway down, a child-sized red coat lies neatly folded on one step, abandoned but dry despite the spray. Far offshore, the horizon is almost invisible beneath fog. One small human silhouette stands on the lowest visible step facing the water. Photograph with subdued colour film, slate blue, charcoal, wet grey stone and one restrained red accent, natural grain and long-exposure softness in the waves. The image should feel like standing at the edge between self and something much larger, with grief and acceptance coexisting. Keep the symbolism quiet rather than theatrical. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, boats or literal album artwork.

title: Levitation
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Levitation.” Photograph a dense grove of mature trees at twilight where all of the lower branches bend unnaturally toward the ground, forming a dark canopy only a few feet high. Beneath them, a young figure in pale clothing appears to hover several centimetres above a carpet of fallen leaves, but the effect should be subtle enough that it might be a trick of perspective. The upper sky should contain the faintest trace of deep cherry red fading into black. Shoot on soft, grainy colour film with low contrast, diffused edges, dark green-black foliage and a controlled crimson glow. The image should feel like growth happening too quickly, memory lowering around someone and physical reality becoming briefly uncertain. Avoid superhero levitation or obvious visual effects. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or album-cover reproduction.

title: Sparks
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Sparks.” Photograph two hands reaching toward each other out of near-total darkness, one from the upper left and one from the lower right, their index fingertips stopped a finger’s width apart. In the narrow gap between them, a tiny white spark hangs impossibly in midair, as if something has just passed from one hand to the other. Everything else should be nearly black. Show real skin texture, knuckle creases and small imperfections rather than polished beauty. Use extremely grainy high-ISO film, monochrome with a faint warm-red tint in the shadows, blown highlights around the spark and shallow depth of field. A subtle double exposure should make one hand appear slightly displaced, like someone returning after disappearing. The image should evoke reanimation, attraction and the instantaneous transfer of something fragile. Keep it quiet and strange rather than dramatic, and avoid any resemblance to classical paintings. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders, fire or obvious lightning bolts.

title: Space Song
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Space Song.” Photograph the interior of an ordinary late-night city bus, almost empty, with blue upholstered seats and fluorescent ceiling lights. Through every bus window is deep outer space rather than city streets: distant stars, faint galaxies and absolute blackness. One passenger sits alone near the back, seen only in silhouette, their reflection duplicated across several windows as though lost in multiple possible locations. A small plastic shopping bag rests on the seat beside them. Use cinematic 35mm colour film with deep navy, cold fluorescent green, faded blue and fine grain. The surrealism should feel quiet and emotionally plausible rather than spectacular. The image should evoke loneliness, displacement and a fragile world continuing to move when someone cannot find what was lost. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, planets or spacesuits.

title: Beyond Love
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Beyond Love.” Show a pair of elegant white gloves resting palms-up on a bedside table. Inside each glove lies a different tiny nightmare-like object: in one, a miniature black staircase descending downward; in the other, a tiny closed bedroom door standing upright. The bed behind them is out of focus and empty. A single lamp creates warm light, while the rest of the room disappears into dark cherry-coloured shadow. Photograph it as a practical surrealist still life on grainy medium-format film, with tactile fabric, worn wood and realistic miniature objects. The composition should suggest that simple parts of a person have been removed and replaced with fears they did not choose. Keep it intimate and psychologically strange rather than horror-themed. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, gore or obvious heart symbolism.

Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “10:37.” Photograph a dark maternity waiting room or hospital corridor at exactly the kind of hour when almost nobody is present, but do not show any readable clocks or signs. A row of plastic chairs sits beneath cold ceiling lights. On one chair is a folded white blanket. Above it, hundreds of tiny points of light gather in a loose spiral that could be dust, stars or reflected particles. At the far end of the corridor, a bright doorway washes out all detail and a barely visible figure appears to be approaching. Use grainy low-light 35mm film, green-grey institutional colour, pale white, deep black and a faint cherry-red cast in the shadows. The feeling should be arrival, totality and something larger passing through an ordinary place. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or overt celestial illustration.

title: PPP
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “PPP.” Photograph a large sheet of glass positioned vertically in a dark ballroom, covered with fine droplets of water. Behind the glass, a formally dressed couple appears to be dancing, but their bodies are smeared by motion and refraction so their identities are impossible to determine. On the viewer’s side of the glass lies a single pale rose and one black dress shoe. A flash catches individual droplets, making them resemble small stars. Use romantic but damaged-looking 35mm film, cream, midnight blue, silver and muted pink, with strong grain, halation and imperfect focus. The image should feel like perfect timing remembered through a surface that prevents the viewer from entering the moment. Avoid wedding photography clichés. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or song-title lettering.

title: Wildflower
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Wildflower.” Photograph a vacant demolition site where broken concrete, rebar and brick fill most of the frame. Growing from one narrow crack in the centre is an extravagant cluster of tiny wildflowers in several subdued colours. Everything beyond the flowers should be almost monochrome grey, making the plants appear unusually vivid without becoming fantastical. A piece of torn wallpaper caught on rebar suggests that a home once occupied the site. Use natural overcast light and highly detailed medium-format film, preserving texture in concrete, rust and petals. Colours should be dusty rather than saturated. The image should communicate making something from what remains, beauty without sentimentality and life emerging from damaged material. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, people or decorative floral-arrangement styling.

title: Days of Candy
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Days of Candy.” Photograph a vast old theatre after the final audience has left. Hundreds of empty red velvet seats descend toward a stage on which a painted night sky is slowly being rolled upward and removed by unseen machinery. Behind the disappearing backdrop is an enormous blank white wall. Confetti resembling tiny candy wrappers covers the aisles, but most pieces are silver or colourless rather than cheerful. A lone figure stands near the stage, extremely small in frame. Use faded cinematic 35mm colour with red velvet, black shadows, pale white and muted gold, visible grain and glowing practical lights. The image should feel like an entire universe being dismantled too soon after something beautiful ends. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or literal candy piles.

title: Majorette
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Majorette.” Photograph an empty high-school gymnasium late at night. At centre court lies a single majorette baton, metallic and slightly scratched, illuminated by one overhead spotlight. Rows of retractable bleachers disappear into darkness. Several paper stars and pieces of old parade ribbon cling to the polished floor as though an event ended hours ago. In the reflective floor, the baton’s reflection should look subtly like two batons crossing even though only one is present. Use grainy black-and-white film with high contrast and a small amount of warm toning, evoking a mysterious mid-century photograph rather than contemporary sports photography. The image should feel ceremonial, adolescent, performative and oddly lonely. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, uniforms or posed performers.

title: The Traveller
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “The Traveller.” Show the interior of a nearly empty overnight train compartment. An old leather suitcase sits on the seat opposite the camera, open just enough to reveal folded clothing and dozens of small photographs. The window shows a landscape blurred completely into horizontal streaks, impossible to identify. Reflected in the glass is the faint face of a passenger, but no passenger is physically visible inside the compartment. A paper cup and an unread book sit on the small table. Photograph on faded colour film with brown leather, olive upholstery, blue-black night and warm compartment light, fine grain and natural motion blur. The feeling should be movement without arrival and identity carried as fragments. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, maps or recognisable destinations.

title: Elegy to the Void
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Elegy to the Void.” Photograph an enormous black rectangular opening cut into the middle of a pale rocky landscape, perfectly flat and completely lightless, like an absence rather than a cave. Wild grass bends toward it despite there being no visible wind. Several white flowers lie at its edge as if placed there in memorial, but no people are present. The sky is almost white and contains no clouds. Use stark black-and-white large-format photography with extraordinary tonal detail in stone and grass, deep absolute black in the void and visible analogue grain. Keep the geometry simple and unsettling. The image should feel solemn, cosmic and beautiful, expressing grief directed toward something too large or empty to answer. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, crosses, graves or fantasy effects.

title: Rough Song
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Rough Song.” Photograph a cheap domestic kitchen after a chaotic gathering. A birthday cake has collapsed onto the floor, several glasses have tipped over, one chair lies on its side and a child’s paper crown is crushed beneath a table leg. The room is illuminated by a single bare overhead bulb, creating unflattering but intimate light. Through the back window, dawn is beginning, rendering the glass pale blue. No people should appear. Shoot with harsh 35mm direct flash mixed with available tungsten light, visible grain, faded yellows, browns, pale blue and small touches of red. The scene should contain both humour and sadness, like the remains of an emotionally complicated night rather than a disaster. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or violence.

title: Somewhere Tonight
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Somewhere Tonight.” Photograph two elderly people slow dancing in a nearly empty community hall, but show them only as soft silhouettes viewed from outside through a rain-streaked window. A mirrored disco ball creates tiny white dots on the ceiling and walls. Several empty folding chairs surround the dance floor, and a coat rests across one of them. The couple should occupy a small portion of the frame so the room itself feels equally important. Use grainy black-and-white or very lightly sepia-toned film with soft focus, glowing highlights and deep shadow. The image should feel as though the photographer happened upon an intimate moment that had existed for decades before they arrived. Tender but unsentimental. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or glamorous nightclub styling.

title: Dark Spring
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Dark Spring.” Photograph a spring orchard at night during an astronomical event. Blossoming trees fill the foreground, but nearly all colour has disappeared from them. Above, the sky glows with a distant cold red phenomenon, while the familiar constellation Orion is partly obscured by an unnatural dark band. Several blossom petals appear suspended motionless in the air. Use experimental infrared-like film colour, deep black, dark crimson, ghostly white and desaturated grey, with heavy grain and slight solarisation. The photograph should appear halfway between astronomy, botany and a damaged art print. The mood is cosmic collision intruding upon an ordinary seasonal rebirth, beautiful but frightening. Do not show telescopes, text, lyrics, logos, borders or literal stars drawn as graphic symbols.

title: Lemon Glow
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Lemon Glow.” Photograph a bedroom at night in which the only illumination comes from a strange yellow glow seeping through closed venetian blinds. The light creates intense horizontal bands across the bed, walls and a person lying awake beneath white sheets. Only one hand and part of a cheek should be visible. The yellow should feel almost liquid, somewhere between sodium streetlight, honey and fluorescent lemon. Deep shadows contain traces of violet and black. Use saturated experimental colour film, noticeable grain, halation, slight chromatic distortion and high contrast. The image should feel feverish, intimate and bodily, as though colour itself is moving through the room and through the person. Avoid actual lemons, neon signs or psychedelic illustration. No text, lyrics, logos or borders.

title: Drunk in LA
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Drunk in LA.” Photograph a dim Los Angeles hotel hallway at 2 a.m. with endless identical doors, low candles placed strangely along the carpet and security cameras visible at several ceiling corners. Halfway down the hall, a person in formal clothes sits on the floor against the wall with their face hidden in their hands. Through an open door at the far end, reveal a bathroom mirror surrounded by harsh vanity bulbs. One wall contains a framed photograph of running horses, slightly crooked. Use grainy cinematic colour film with amber candlelight, dirty cream walls, black shadows and hints of faded Hollywood red. The mood should mix glamour, surveillance, isolation, memory and self-awareness. Do not include alcohol branding, text, lyrics, logos or borders.

title: Black Car
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Black Car.” Photograph a perfectly black sedan parked beside a frozen lake at night. Its windows are opaque and no interior is visible. In the immediate foreground, a single flat stone is captured halfway through a skip across the ice, but there are no ripples because the water appears impossibly solid and still. Headlights remain off. Behind the vehicle, bare trees vanish into blackness. Use extremely dark low-key photography with just enough silver-grey moonlight to reveal the car’s contours, textured ice and tree trunks. Shoot on high-grain black-and-white film with crushed blacks and subtle halation. The image should feel cold, enclosed and tomb-like, with stillness becoming the central subject. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, drivers or obvious horror elements.

title: Girl of the Year
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Girl of the Year.” Photograph a dressing room after a televised performance. A vanity mirror surrounded by bulbs dominates the frame. On the counter are dozens of daisy petals, false eyelashes, makeup, hairpins and one dried tear-shaped droplet caught in spilled glitter. The chair is empty. In the mirror, instead of reflecting the room, show a western sunset over an open highway. The television in the corner displays only white static. Use grainy saturated 1980s colour film with hot pink, warm sunset orange, black, cream and washed blue. Combine beauty, exhaustion and artificial performance without showing the woman herself. The image should feel like celebrity evaporating once the camera turns off. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or readable television graphics.

title: Once Twice Melody
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Once Twice Melody.” Photograph a tree-lined boulevard in summer with a solitary woman walking away from the camera. The scene should appear as a subtle double exposure: the same woman appears again several metres ahead, slightly transparent, creating the sense that one moment has happened once and then twice. Purple vines climb one side of the frame, while velvety dark trees line the opposite side. Raindrops suspended on the lens catch a bright afternoon sun. Use luxurious medium-format colour film with soft gold, lilac, deep green and velvety black, fine grain and gentle halation. The image should feel romantic, cyclical and almost fairy-tale-like while remaining rooted in real photography. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, cartoon imagery or overt fantasy costumes.

title: Superstar
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Superstar.” Photograph a car driving extremely fast down an empty highway at night from the perspective of someone in the passenger seat. Lane markings stretch into long white flashes. In the rear-view mirror, instead of the road behind, show an old photograph of two people standing against a wall in bright backlight. High in the dark windshield, one unusually bright star remains sharp while every other light smears from speed. Keep the driver completely out of frame. Use cinematic 35mm colour film, deep midnight blue, white streaks, muted red dashboard glow, heavy grain and motion blur. The image should convey someone gone but permanently fixed in memory, speed unable to outrun an image. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or glamorous celebrity portraiture.

title: Pink Funeral
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Pink Funeral.” Stage a surreal but photographic theatrical set: a black indoor lake surrounded by painted scenery, with two white swans gliding beneath artificial stars hanging visibly from wires. At the water’s edge lies a discarded white lace veil stained pale pink by stage lighting. The painted blue sky backdrop is partly rolled away, revealing black rigging behind it. Several strings of a small orchestra are visible only as abandoned instruments and music stands, with no musicians. Photograph on richly textured medium-format film with dusty pink, black, ivory and faded blue, glowing highlights and visible grain. The scene should look like a fairy tale dismantling itself in real time, theatrical illusion exposed without becoming kitsch. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or actual funeral ceremony.

title: Over and Over
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Over and Over.” Photograph a long hotel corridor where the same small arrangement repeats at regular intervals: identical table, identical lamp, identical vase, identical closed door. The repetitions should continue far beyond realistic architectural depth. At the nearest table, one flower has fallen from its vase, breaking the otherwise perfect pattern. Ceiling lights fade toward a vanishing point. Use symmetrical large-format photography with deep blacks, muted cream, dull gold and a faint midnight-blue cast, subtle film grain and gentle lens distortion. The repetition should initially feel soothing and then increasingly uncanny. The image should evoke cycles, returning memories and time moving forward by repeating itself. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, mirrors or obvious digital cloning artifacts.

title: Modern Love Stories
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Modern Love Stories.” Photograph a dark apartment at night containing evidence of two people without showing either person: two illuminated phone screens lying face-down several feet apart, a laptop asleep on a table, two half-finished glasses of water and two coats hanging beside the door. Through the large window, dozens of neighbouring apartment windows reveal tiny anonymous domestic scenes, each isolated in its own square of light. One white curtain billows inward despite the window appearing closed. Use contemporary cinematic photography but process it to resemble slightly faded 35mm film, with navy, black, cool white and warm window amber. The image should feel intimate and disconnected at the same time, capturing love mediated by modern spaces and devices without depicting technology as inherently sinister. No text, lyrics, logos or borders.

title: American Daughter
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “American Daughter.” Photograph a young woman underwater in the deep end of an ordinary public swimming pool, fully clothed in pale everyday clothes. She should look upward toward the shimmering surface while hundreds of small heart-shaped paper letters float above the water and cast distorted shadows downward. One part of the pool is monochrome grey, while another area transitions unexpectedly into vivid technicolour red, cyan and yellow as though two film stocks overlap. The visual effect should remain photographic and organic, created through double exposure and analogue colour shifts rather than digital fantasy. Use fine grain, underwater softness, refracted light and slight scratches. The mood should be fascination, memory, identity and emotional contradiction. No text, lyrics, logos, borders, flags or patriotic imagery.

title: Holiday House
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Holiday House.” Photograph a long rural driveway at night leading toward an old summer house barely visible through tall corn and trees. A car’s headlights illuminate only the first section of driveway. Beside the house is a dark swimming pool reflecting the Milky Way so clearly that the pool seems deeper than the sky. Through one window, a warm fire burns and a group of old framed photographs can be seen on a mantel, but no people are visible. A mourning dove rests on a telephone wire in silhouette. Use grainy 1970s colour-film aesthetics with deep blue-black night, warm amber interiors, dry corn gold and slightly scuzzy texture. The image should feel like returning to a place where happiness survives mainly in photographs. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or obvious vacation imagery.

title: Become
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Become.” Photograph a human silhouette standing inside a completely dark room at sunrise. Instead of sunlight simply falling onto the person, warm crystalline light appears to originate from inside their torso and gradually pass through their clothing, fingertips and face, illuminating floating dust around them. A small bowl of deep red berries or ruby-coloured fruit rests on a table in the foreground as the only saturated object. The window behind the figure is bright enough to erase the outside landscape entirely. Shoot as a practical-looking analogue photograph with warm gold, black, ivory and ruby red, fine grain, gentle bloom and slight overexposure around the internal light. Keep the transformation ambiguous and peaceful, not supernatural or religious. The final card should feel like emergence, acceptance and becoming light. No text, lyrics, logos, borders or literal band imagery.

title: Irene
prompt: Create a single vertical 3:4 photographic art card inspired by the Beach House song “Irene,” whose album hides one more song after a long silence. Photograph an empty small-town dance hall long after the last song has ended. The folding chairs are stacked against the walls, the wooden floor is swept, and every light is out. In the far corner a portable record player sits open on a folding table, its tone arm still resting on the record, a tiny amber pilot light the only warm point in the room. Through a high window the first cold blue of dawn is arriving. Fine dust hangs motionless in the air as though the room is holding its breath, waiting for something more to play. Use grainy, slightly underexposed 35mm colour film with blue-black shadows, pale dawn blue, worn honey-coloured wood and one small amber glow, soft halation and gentle vignetting. The image should feel like the moment after the ending that turns out not to be the end: patience, devotion and a secret kept for whoever stays. Do not include text, lyrics, logos, borders or people.
